question: Does the retained original ABBO table explicitly record the five-taxon measurements absent from eight current Neotoma sample panels, after complete exact depth and shared-count correspondence?

source_scope.original: Giesecke (2010), doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.738429, archived from EPD on 2010-05-11; event ABBO, original collection date 2002-06-15. The table names sediment depth in metres and count fields in #. No original sample-ID column or missing/zero convention is declared in the header.
source_scope.current: Neotoma dataset 19913, site 13338, collection unit 14910, handle ABBO, European Pollen Database, doi:10.21233/2vzb-bg61, Giesecke. Native pollen count units NISP and canonical JSON integer values are retained; depth units are not explicit in the response.
source_scope.metadata_limits: Shared owner/handle and close site coordinates are leads, not physical-core authority. Preserve PANGAEA elevation start 387 m/end 6.5 m and Neotoma altitude 374 m without equating or correcting those fields. Archival and collection dates are provenance, not sample ages.
source_scope.prior_work: The earlier 107-depth/2183-count Rootsi ABB.xls comparison concerns a separate source. Existing fixed-age/age-mixture five-taxon profiles used only the PANGAEA descriptive area header and leave eight absent current-native cells unresolved. Those results and source scopes remain unchanged.

join.rule: Exact Decimal arithmetic, without binary floating-point conversion or nearest matching. Require unique complete 107-to-107 depth equality after scaling original metres by 100. Report duplicate/unmatched depths and source ordering; do not silently collapse rows, interpolate or declare a native depth unit.
join.identity_limit: Assign native sample IDs to original rows only after the complete depth bijection. Count agreement supports correspondence of the exported series, not an independent measurement, aliquot/core identity, species-level concept equivalence or historical LandClim selection.

count_comparison.precondition: Every one of the 527 explicitly reported current-native measurements must equal a valid nonnegative integer in its uniquely joined original field before eight absent-native cells are presented as support candidates. Any mismatch or wrong reported population withholds candidate conclusions, while recording aggregate failures and up to eight diagnostic examples.
count_comparison.token_rule: Retain literal cells. Finite nonnegative mathematically integral original decimal tokens, including 0.0, are explicit counts. Empty or whitespace cells remain blank; nonfinite, negative, nonintegral and unparsed tokens remain invalid with reasons. An explicit numeric zero is recorded source-count evidence, not proof of biological absence. No omitted current datum or blank original cell becomes zero.
count_comparison.morphology: Retain the exact original parameter names and EPD morphological comments alongside native IDs. Matching exported numbers does not promote Juniperus-type, Pinus diploxylon-type or Gramineae into newly reviewed species concepts or a PPE-transfer decision.
count_comparison.audit: Complete depth-pair and 535-slot scientific-data digests use canonical JSON, sorted object keys, UTF-8, no whitespace, in ascending native exact depth/sample ID then declared five-taxon order. Rational native-depth keys preserve exact comparisons. Compact results contain five taxon counters and at most eight absence candidates, not the full original table.

rights_and_use.original: Retained source declares Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported. This is a local noncommercial descriptive scientific comparison with attribution to Thomas Giesecke, EPD and PANGAEA. It does not upgrade original terms to the current Neotoma release terms or infer blanket commercial/public redistribution authority.
rights_and_use.outputs: Native original table/matrix and source files remain external and unchanged. Comparison outputs remain local artifacts. The existing source-method account may describe qualified factual correspondence and refusals; no raw original count-table redistribution is authorized by this protocol.
rights_and_use.future_use: Any later source-augmented conditional calculation requires its own declared source/profile and preserves prior missing-panel results. This comparison alone imputes nothing, changes no source observation, reruns no age/PPE consumer and admits no physical or historical LRA core.
